description.value: J & V Restaurant is a Chinese cuisine kitchen in Castlegar serving an extensive menu of Cantonese and Szechuan classics — from wonton soup and chow mein to Szechuan prawns and dry garlic pork. The business operates exclusively as drive-through pickup with no dine-in or delivery, making it a quick stop for touring cyclists passing through the Castlegar area. Catering is also available on request.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms J & V Restaurant is a Chinese takeout-only restaurant with a drive-through window at 2816 Columbia Avenue, Castlegar, BC — not Trail as the OSM pin suggests. The OSM record has no address or phone, so the website is the sole source for contact details. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water, or cycling amenities anywhere on the site.
